project.description: Fail-closed banner rollback guard. Requires ordered operator attestations, retains the forward schema, recreates PSAMA and backend services, and leaves httpd stopped below the targeting-capable backend boundary.

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: rollback-state.json
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: Machine-readable pre-backend rollback state. See README.md.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -e export CURRENT_FS_DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR=/usr/local/docker-config/ export AIO_ROLLOUT_CONTRACT_FILE=/scripts/banner-rollout-contract.json export AIO_ROLLOUT_SOURCE_FILE=/scripts/banner-rollout-source.json export AIO_START_SCRIPT=/scripts/start-picsure.sh /scripts/rollback-picsure.sh rollback-state.json
